panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Look at that storage density. We've finally maximized the cubic volume.
panels.scene: A manager proudly pointing to a massive industrial shelf that is visibly bowing in the middle, with one single bolt popping out of the frame.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Three hundred days without an accident! This team is unstoppable.
panels.scene: The manager standing in front of a safety scoreboard; behind him, a massive rack is slowly tilting at a 15-degree angle over the entire staff.

panels.speaker: Chief
panels.line: We cannot enter a burning building without a signed 40-page Risk Assessment Form.
panels.scene: The Chief holding a thick stack of papers in front of a raging fire.

panels.speaker: Firefighter
panels.line: But the roof is literally collapsing!
panels.scene: A firefighter pointing up at debris falling from a ceiling.

panels.speaker: Chief
panels.line: Exactly. Which is why I've added a special section for 'Falling Debris' on page 32.
panels.scene: The Chief proudly flipping to a specific page of the document while the building crashes behind him.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: You can't have a structural fire if you remove all the structures.
panels.scene: A man pointing to his head with a smug expression; in the background is just a flat, empty concrete lot where a building used to be.

panels.speaker: Chef
panels.line: The Risotto is off the menu. It takes too long and kills the flow.
panels.scene: Chef crossing out 'Risotto' on a printed menu with a thick red marker.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: We need something unique for the weekend. Let's run a special.
panels.scene: Manager leaning over the counter, looking thoughtful.

panels.speaker: Server
panels.line: Tonight's special is the Risotto.
panels.scene: Server talking to customers; in the background, the Chef is staring at the wall in despair.

panels.speaker: Project Manager
panels.line: Our safety audit is a disaster. Too many documented violations per site.
panels.scene: A Project Manager in a clean hardhat staring at a clipboard with many red marks.

panels.speaker: Site Foreman
panels.line: I've taken care of it. The audit looks perfect now.
panels.scene: The Foreman smiling confidently, holding an empty folder.

panels.speaker: Project Manager
panels.line: Impressive. How did you fix the site?
panels.scene: Project Manager looking pleased, glancing at a report.

panels.speaker: Site Foreman
panels.line: I burned the audit forms.
panels.scene: Wide shot of the Foreman standing next to a trash can fire with papers burning inside; in the background, a worker is precariously balancing on a ladder.

panels.speaker: The dog
panels.line: The Site Foreman
panels.scene: Foreman sitting at a desk in a trailer.

panels.speaker: The fire/chaos
panels.line: Major structural cracks appearing in the walls
panels.scene: Walls splitting open and ceiling tiles falling.

panels.speaker: The speech bubble
panels.line: We're still on schedule.
panels.scene: Foreman sipping coffee with a deadpan expression.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: Celebrating another year of meeting targets to qualify for the bonus promised last year.
panels.scene: A group of tired nurses in a breakroom, staring blankly at a single, tiny cupcake on a table.

panels.speaker: Drake disgusted
panels.line: Hiring two full-time nurses to fix the ratio
panels.scene: The hand gesturing 'no'.

panels.speaker: Drake pleased
panels.line: A memo stating we are 'actively reviewing staffing requirements'
panels.scene: The hand gesturing 'yes' with a smile.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: Another quiet shift.
panels.scene: A firefighter calmly reads a paperback at the day room desk. Behind him, a fire truck tire slowly flattens, brake fluid leaks in a widening puddle, and a ceiling sprinkler pipe drips steadily onto a stack of unpaid maintenance invoices.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: We're fully compliant and ready for review.
panels.scene: The station chief stands proudly with a thumbs-up next to a spotless locker room where every helmet is aligned and every shelf is color-coded. Through a glass window behind him, the engine bay is completely empty except for a 'Budget Pending' sign taped to a rusted ladder.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: We eliminated all interior construction delays by removing the floors.
panels.scene: Foreman stands proudly next to a freshly poured elevator shaft that drops straight into the ground with no landings, doors, or staircases. A clipboard reading 'On Schedule' is pinned to the rebar.

panels.speaker: Electrician
panels.line: Wires are routed through the false ceiling.
panels.scene: Electrician smiles, holding a finished junction box. Neat cables disappear into an open grid ceiling.

panels.speaker: Drywall Team
panels.line: Ceiling is sealed and painted.
panels.scene: Drywall crew steps back from a pristine, freshly painted ceiling. The grid is completely covered.

panels.speaker: Plumber
panels.line: We found a leak. Cutting it open to fix it.
panels.scene: Plumber holds a reciprocating saw mid-cut, already breaking through the painted ceiling. Electrician and drywall crew watch in the background, shoulders slumped.

panels.speaker: The boyfriend
panels.line: Rig Supervisor
panels.scene: The man looking back with desire.

panels.speaker: The woman in red
panels.line: AI-powered drilling optimization software
panels.scene: The attractive woman walking past.

panels.speaker: The girlfriend
panels.line: Basic fire safety checklists
panels.scene: The shocked woman being left behind.

liked.note: this and the one above which is based on women in red, boyfriend and girlfriend setup are nice!

panels.speaker: Environmental Officer
panels.line: We have a slow seep in the secondary containment. We need to patch the concrete.
panels.scene: An officer pointing at a puddle of oil forming around a base.

panels.speaker: Operations Lead
panels.line: Patching is boring. I've just bought an array of real-time IoT sensors to track the leak in 4K!
panels.scene: The lead showing off a sleek tablet with colorful graphs and high-res maps.

panels.speaker: Operations Lead
panels.line: Look at that data visualization. It's beautiful.
panels.scene: Close up of the tablet showing a huge red blotch, while in the background, the oil has reached the ocean.

panels.speaker: Chief
panels.line: I know the paperwork is a nightmare. I'm implementing a streamlined digital portal to save you time.
panels.scene: The Chief presents a sleek tablet on a podium to a room of skeptical officers.

panels.speaker: Officer
panels.line: Finally.
panels.scene: An officer sighs in relief, leaning back in their chair.

panels.speaker: Captain
panels.line: The digital portal is live. Please print out the confirmation receipt and file it in triplicate.
panels.scene: The officer is now staring at a massive stack of printed papers next to the tablet.

panels.speaker: Drake disgusted
panels.line: Authorizing a cost-of-living adjustment for veteran officers
panels.scene: Drake looking away in disgust.

panels.speaker: Drake pleased
panels.line: A memo stating we are 'exploring various incentive structures'
panels.scene: Drake smiling and pointing approvingly.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: We spent the entire renovation budget on cinematic mood lighting to hide the holes in the floor.
panels.scene: A wide shot of a gym with incredibly dramatic, high-end neon purple and blue lighting. In the foreground, a member is nearly tripping over a massive, jagged hole in the rubber flooring.

panels.speaker: Button 1
panels.line: Buy new equipment and hire more staff
panels.scene: A red button on a console.

panels.speaker: Button 2
panels.line: Require a notarized letter and 30 days' notice to cancel membership
panels.scene: The other red button.

panels.speaker: The Manager
panels.line: Management sweating while deciding, then slamming the second button with full force.
panels.scene: A manager in a suit looking intensely stressed before decisively smashing Button 2.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: Reading the 'Wellness Initiative' handbook at 3:00 AM.
panels.scene: A dark office. A single desk lamp illuminates a lawyer who looks like a ghost, reading a colorful brochure titled 'Work-Life Balance'.

panels.speaker: IT Manager
panels.line: This software is obsolete. We're migrating to a modern platform next month.
panels.scene: A lawyer staring at a screen with an 'Error 404' message; the IT manager stands behind them gesturing to a roadmap.

panels.speaker: Lawyer
panels.line: Thank god. I can't spend another year fighting this interface.
panels.scene: The lawyer looks relieved, almost tearful.

panels.speaker: IT Manager
panels.line: Migration complete. It's the same system, but now it's blue.
panels.scene: The lawyer is staring at the exact same error message, but the window border is now light blue.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: Improving crew morale with a 'Wellness Wednesday' email during a double-shift week.
panels.scene: A exhausted flight attendant asleep standing up against a galley wall, while their phone screen glows with an email titled 'Tips for Better Sleep'.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Too many lost bags. We need better visibility in the system.
panels.scene: A manager looking at a screen showing baggage icons moving on a map.

panels.speaker: Developer
panels.line: Done. I've added real-time GPS tracking to every single suitcase.
panels.scene: The developer proudly presenting a high-tech dashboard with thousands of blinking dots.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Amazing! Now we can watch in real-time as the bag is sent to the wrong continent.
panels.scene: The manager staring at a dot moving rapidly away from its destination toward another country.

panels.speaker: Warehouse lead
panels.line: This vintage shipment is double-boxed, climate-controlled, and on a dedicated lift.
panels.scene: Carefully secured pallet of high-value crates sits undisturbed. Lead inspects the tags with a satisfied nod.

panels.speaker: Compliance officer
panels.scene: Foreground shows the crates perfectly safe. Background shows the officer creeping closer, stamp raised like a gavel, ready to strike the manifest.

panels.speaker: Compliance officer
panels.line: Protocol says all cargo must be treated equally. We'll just drive.
panels.scene: The Fragile tags are now covered by identical Bulk stamps. Officer stands proudly as the forklift driver nods and engages the lift.

panels.speaker: Cold chain supervisor
panels.line: Temperature's been perfect for months. Nothing's thawed.
panels.scene: Inside a freezer aisle. Digital display reads -20°C. Supervisor checks a clipboard, satisfied.

panels.speaker: Energy coordinator
panels.scene: Foreground shows frozen goods stacked neatly. Background shows the coordinator creeping toward the thermostat, finger hovering over the touchscreen labeled Dynamic Load Balancing.

panels.speaker: Energy coordinator
panels.line: Perfect. Now it matches the rest of the building. We'll just trust the packaging.
panels.scene: Display flips to 22°C. Ice forms on the coordinator's tablet as the room warms. Coordinator stands smiling beside the adjusted dial.

panels.speaker: Chef
panels.line: Out of stock. It's gone until tomorrow.
panels.scene: Chef slams a red "86" tag over a menu item on the digital pass screen.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Reservations are full. Print the tickets.
panels.scene: The same "86" tag instantly flips back to green "Available" on the screen.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Refunded. Process fixed. Won't happen again.
panels.scene: Manager stamps a kitchen ticket with a large red "COMP" stamp and files it away.

panels.speaker: Manager
panels.line: Stamp it. The review says we care.
panels.scene: An identical ticket drops from the printer, with the exact same error noted in the margin.

panels.speaker: Caption
panels.line: Manager: "We’re reviewing every submission this week." They drop identical requests in the overflowing box.
panels.scene: A large metal suggestion box sits on a break room table, visibly stuffed to the brim with folded paper. A manager holds a megaphone and gestures to a line of staff, each handing in a freshly folded, identically shaped paper.
